title: Checking Calculations in Common Size Statements
title_hi: समान माप के विवरणों में गणनाओं की जाँच
body:
To check whether all the calculations are correct or not, ascertain figure of any component on the basis of amount of another component. For example, if the percentage of net purchase of 2017 is 70% and the amount is ₹ 11,20,000. On the basis of the percentage of income tax (9%), the amount of income tax can be determined as follows:

**Amount of income tax** = (Amount of net purchase / Percentage of net purchase) × Percentage of income tax
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 9 = ₹ 1,44,000

Likewise, the amount of depreciation (12%) can be calculated:
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 12 = ₹ 1,92,000
body_hi:
यह जाँचने के लिए कि सभी गणनाएँ सही हैं या नहीं, किसी अन्य घटक की राशि के आधार पर किसी भी घटक का आंकड़ा सुनिश्चित करें। उदाहरण के लिए, यदि 2017 की शुद्ध खरीद का प्रतिशत 70% है और राशि ₹ 11,20,000 है। आयकर के प्रतिशत (9%) के आधार पर, आयकर की राशि निम्नानुसार निर्धारित की जा सकती है:

**आयकर की राशि** = (शुद्ध खरीद की राशि / शुद्ध खरीद का प्रतिशत) × आयकर का प्रतिशत
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 9 = ₹ 1,44,000

इसी तरह, मूल्यह्रास की राशि (12%) की गणना की जा सकती है:
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 12 = ₹ 1,92,000
body_gu:
બધી ગણતરીઓ સાચી છે કે નહીં તે ચકાસવા માટે, અન્ય ઘટકની રકમના આધારે કોઈપણ ઘટકની આકૃતિ નક્કી કરો. ઉદાહરણ તરીકે, જો 2017 ની ચોખ્ખી ખરીદીની ટકાવારી 70% છે અને રકમ ₹ 11,20,000 છે. આવકવેરાની ટકાવારી (9%) ના આધારે, આવકવેરાની રકમ નીચે મુજબ નક્કી કરી શકાય છે:

**આવકવેરાની રકમ** = (ચોખ્ખી ખરીદીની રકમ / ચોખ્ખી ખરીદીની ટકાવારી) × આવકવેરાની ટકાવારી
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 9 = ₹ 1,44,000

તેવી જ રીતે, ઘસારાની રકમ (12%) ની ગણતરી કરી શકાય છે:
= (11,20,000 / 70) × 12 = ₹ 1,92,000

title: Illustration 19: Complete Common Size Balance Sheet
title_hi: उदाहरण 19: पूर्ण समान माप का आर्थिक चिट्ठा
title_gu: ઉદાહરણ 19: સંપૂર્ણ સમાન માપનું પાકું સરવૈયું
question:
The common size balance sheets as at 31-3-2016 and 31-3-2017 with balancing figures of Amarnath Limited are as follows. Ascertain balancing figures and complete common size balance sheet.

| Particulars | Note No. | Amount (₹) 31-3-2016 | Amount (₹) 31-3-2017 | Percentage 31-3-2016 (%) | Percentage 31-3-2017 (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **(I) Equity and Liabilities** | | | | | |
| **(1) Shareholders’ funds :** | | | | | |
| (a) Share capital | | 14,00,000 | ? | 50 | 50 |
| (b) Reserves and surplus | | 3,50,000 | ? | 12.5 | 10 |
| **(2) Non-current liabilities** | | | | | |
| Long-term borrowings | | 7,00,000 | ? | 25 | 30 |
| **(3) Current liabilities** | | | | | |
| (i) Trade payables | | 2,00,000 | ? | 7.14 | 8 |
| (ii) Other liabilities | | 1,50,000 | ? | 5.36 | 2 |
| **Total** | | **28,00,000** | **42,00,000** | **100** | **100** |
| **(II) Assets** | | | | | |
| **(1) Non-current assets :** | | | | | |
| (a) Fixed assets | | | | | |
| (i) Tangible assets | | ? | 20,00,000 | 45 | 47.62 |
| (ii) Intangible assets | | ? | 15,70,000 | 40 | 37.38 |
| **(2) Current assets :** | | | | | |
| (i) Trade receivables | | ? | 5,00,000 | 10 | 11.90 |
| (ii) Cash and cash equivalent | | ? | 1,30,000 | 5 | 3.10 |
| **Total** | | **28,00,000** | **42,00,000** | **100** | **100** |
explanation:
The total of the balance sheet is the base of all assets and liabilities for common size balance sheets. The proportion of the assets and liabilities is ascertained as a percentage of the total of the balance sheet.

**Amount of liability/asset of respective year** = Total of balance sheet of respective year × Percentage of respective liability/asset

**Calculations for 2017 (Equity-liabilities side):**
1. Share capital = 42,00,000 × 50 / 100 = ₹ 21,00,000
2. Reserves and surplus = 42,00,000 × 10 / 100 = ₹ 4,20,000
3. Long-term borrowings = 42,00,000 × 30 / 100 = ₹ 12,60,000
4. Trade payables = 42,00,000 × 8 / 100 = ₹ 3,36,000
5. Other liabilities = 42,00,000 × 2 / 100 = ₹ 84,000

**Calculations for 2016 (Assets side):**
1. Tangible assets = 28,00,000 × 45 / 100 = ₹ 12,60,000
2. Intangible assets = 28,00,000 × 40 / 100 = ₹ 11,20,000
3. Trade receivables = 28,00,000 × 10 / 100 = ₹ 2,80,000
4. Cash and cash equivalent = 28,00,000 × 5 / 100 = ₹ 1,40,000

By replacing the '?' with these calculated amounts, the Common Size Balance Sheet is completed.

title: Illustration 20: Find Out Balancing Figures
title_hi: उदाहरण 20: संतुलन के आंकड़े ज्ञात करें
question:
Find out balancing figures of common size balance sheet as at 31-3-2016 and 31-3-2017 of Dahod Ltd.

| Particulars | Note No. | Amount (₹) 31-3-2016 | Amount (₹) 31-3-2017 | Percentage 31-3-2016 (%) | Percentage 31-3-2017 (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **(I) Equity and Liabilities** | | | | | |
| **(1) Shareholders’ funds :** | | | | | |
| (a) Share capital | | | | | |
| (i) Equity share capital | | ? | 14,52,000 | 20 | 22 |
| (ii) Preference share capital | | ? | 7,26,000 | 10 | 11 |
| (b) Reserves and surplus | | | | | |
| (i) General reserve | | ? | 3,63,000 | 10 | 5.5 |
| (ii) Profit-loss account | | ? | 14,52,000 | 20 | 22 |
| **(2) Non-current liabilities** | | | | | |
| (i) 15 % debentures | | ? | 7,26,000 | 10 | 11 |
| (ii) Loan of BOB | | ? | 7,26,000 | 10 | 11 |
| **(3) Current liabilities** | | | | | |
| (i) Short-term borrowings | | ? | 3,63,000 | 8 | 5.5 |
| (ii) Other current liabilities | | ? | 3,63,000 | 7 | 5.5 |
| (iii) Short-term provisions | | ? | 4,29,000 | 5 | 6.5 |
| **Total** | | **50,00,000** | **66,00,000** | **100** | **100** |
| **(II) Assets** | | | | | |
| **(1) Non-current assets :** | | | | | |
| (a) Fixed assets | | | | | |
| (i) Tangible assets | | | | | |
| Land | | 15,00,000 | 19,80,000 | 30 | ? |
| Plant-machines | | 5,00,000 | 6,60,000 | 10 | ? |
| Building | | 7,50,000 | 11,88,000 | 15 | ? |
| (b) Non-current investments | | 10,00,000 | 7,92,000 | 20 | ? |
| **(2) Current assets :** | | | | | |
| (i) Current investments | | 5,00,000 | 9,90,000 | 10 | ? |
| (ii) Stock | | 5,00,000 | 6,60,000 | 10 | ? |
| (iii) Cash - cash equivalent | | 2,50,000 | 3,30,000 | 5 | ? |
| **Total** | | **50,00,000** | **66,00,000** | **100** | **100** |
explanation:
This illustration is mixed in nature. For 2016, we need to find the amount on the equity and liabilities side using the percentage. For 2017, we need to find the percentage on the assets side using the amount.

1. **Amount in rupees for equity and liabilities side of year 2016** = (Total of balance sheet of 2016 × Percentage of respective liability) / 100
- Equity share capital = (50,00,000 × 20) / 100 = ₹ 10,00,000
- Preference share capital = (50,00,000 × 10) / 100 = ₹ 5,00,000
- General reserve = (50,00,000 × 10) / 100 = ₹ 5,00,000
- Profit-loss account = (50,00,000 × 20) / 100 = ₹ 10,00,000
- 15% debentures = (50,00,000 × 10) / 100 = ₹ 5,00,000
- Loan of BOB = (50,00,000 × 10) / 100 = ₹ 5,00,000
- Short-term borrowings = (50,00,000 × 8) / 100 = ₹ 4,00,000
- Other current liabilities = (50,00,000 × 7) / 100 = ₹ 3,50,000
- Short-term provisions = (50,00,000 × 5) / 100 = ₹ 2,50,000

2. **Percentage of assets side of year 2017** = (Amount of respective asset / Total of balance sheet) × 100
- Land = (19,80,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 30%
- Plant-machines = (6,60,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 10%
- Building = (11,88,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 18%
- Non-current investments = (7,92,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 12%
- Current investments = (9,90,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 15%
- Stock = (6,60,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 10%
- Cash and cash equivalent = (3,30,000 / 66,00,000) × 100 = 5%
